added.name: Quivly AI
added.long_description:
Hi YC, we're Chandrika and Tanay, co-founders of Quivly.

TL;DR: Quivly is the agentic workspace for everything after the sale. Our agents turn kickoff calls into launch plans, chase blockers, catch risk and expansion signals, and have the full account story ready at renewal. With Quivly, companies are able to take their customers live in 7 days instead of 30, and then grow revenue from these customers by 4.3x on avg.

https://youtu.be/FbxhxXCW2zc

Everyone rings the gong when the deal closes. But that's when the real work starts. The work after the sale is scattered across Slack threads, spreadsheets, calls, tickets, and someone's memory. Quivly brings it together and turns it into outcomes.

One account, one year with Quivly

Day 1: Onboarding. The kickoff call ends and Quivly has already turned it into a plan, shared with the customer in their own portal. If something blocks launch, like an SSO config, the agent follows up with the right person. With Quivly, our customers have reduced their time to value by 77%, going from live in 30 days to live in 7.

Month 4: Risk. Usage starts to slip, and a support ticket is sitting in another tool. Quivly connects the dots before your CSM has to, and the walkthrough is already booked.

Month 9: Expansion. The customer acquires another company. Quivly catches the news, ties it to the account, and flags the expansion opportunity to your account manager.

Month 12: Renewal. No piecing together the story. What shipped, what changed, where Quivly stepped in, and where the customer can grow next is all in one place.

Use Quivly in the app, in Slack, or through our MCP.

Traction
- Over 10,000 accounts under management
- 77% faster time to value (30 → 7 days)
- 4.3x average revenue expansion with Quivly
- 8 hours saved per FDE per week 

Team

Chandrika Maheshwari (CEO): 2x founder (previously founded Pull, payroll-linked lending). ~15 years at Plaid, Docusign, Google, and Bain, where she built internal tools to fix fragmented customer data. MIT grad.

Tanay Agrawal (CTO): Founding PM at Atlan, scaling it 0 to to $2M ARR and 200 enterprise customers in 50 countries. Solo-built an app to 200K downloads in 6 weeks. Led pricing and billing infra at JPMorgan Payments ($2B annual volume). CMU grad.

Our ask:

If you answer “yes” to any of these, we’d love your help -

- Are you the founder of a B2B company, have customers and reached the scale where you're starting to lose pulse on your customers?
- Are you an FDE, CSM or Account Manager at a B2B SaaS or AI company?
- Do you know Head of FDE or CS at B2B SaaS or AI companies?

Please book time with us: cal.com/chandrika/30min
or reach us at chandrika@quivly.ai

Your help can make a huge difference. Thank you!
